basic_details.job_title: JNCU Part-time Programme Coordinator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Jananayak Chandrashekhar University, Ballia (जननायक चन्द्रशेखर विश्वविद्यालय, बलिया) is filling the post of Part-time Programme Coordinator (अंशकालिक कार्यक्रम समन्वयक) of the National Service Scheme, and only qualified teachers of colleges affiliated to the university may apply. Applications on the prescribed form must be sent only by registered or speed post to the Registrar, Jananayak Chandrashekhar University, Ballia, by 17 December 2026. The notice states that no application will be accepted after that date.

age_limit.details: The applicant should be not more than 50 years of age at the time of selection of the Programme Coordinator. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

qualification.details: The notice lists the following qualifications and particulars for the post: | The applicant should be working as Reader / Lecturer (Selection Grade) or Lecturer (Senior Grade) in this university or an affiliated college. Principals of colleges affiliated to the university who have a National Service Scheme background and the status of Reader may also be considered for appointment as Coordinator. Teachers who have served as Programme Officer under the National Service Scheme for a minimum of 03 years. The applicant should have completed the NSS orientation course at a TOC (Training Oriented Center) / TORC (Training Oriented and Research Center). | For the full eligibility of the post, refer to the official notification and the details on the university website. | The applicant should be not more than 50 years of age at the time of selection of the Programme Coordinator. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. | An honorarium (Pocket Allowance) of Rs. 500/- (five hundred) per month is fixed for performing the work of this post. The post is part-time.

important_instructions: Only qualified teachers of colleges affiliated to Jananayak Chandrashekhar University may apply. Applications are invited only by registered or speed post. No application will be accepted after 17 December 2026, and such applications will not be considered.

rows.details: Part-time Programme Coordinator, National Service Scheme
Teacher (Reader / Lecturer) of the university or an affiliated college with NSS Programme Officer experience and NSS orientation course
Not more than 50 years at the time of selection
Jananayak Chandrashekhar University, Ballia, Uttar Pradesh

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application by registered or speed post to this address: Registrar, Jananayak Chandrashekhar University, Ballia, Shaheed Smarak, Near Surha Taal, District Ballia, U.P., PIN Code 277001 The notice says the qualifications and detailed particulars of the post are uploaded on the university website, www.jncu.ac.in . Page 2 of the notice also mentions handing in the application in person at the Registrar's office in the university's administrative building, but with an old date printed for it; candidates should verify this option from the latest official notice and use registered or speed post as the notice directs.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following qualifications and particulars for the post: The applicant should be working as Reader / Lecturer (Selection Grade) or Lecturer (Senior Grade) in this university or an affiliated college. Principals of colleges affiliated to the university who have a National Service Scheme background and the status of Reader may also be considered for appointment as Coordinator. Teachers who have served as Programme Officer under the National Service Scheme for a minimum of 03 years. The applicant should have completed the NSS orientation course at a TOC (Training Oriented Center) / TORC (Training Oriented and Research Center). For the full eligibility of the post, refer to the official notification and the details on the university website. The applicant should be not more than 50 years of age at the time of selection of the Programme Coordinator. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. An honorarium (Pocket Allowance) of Rs. 500/- (five hundred) per month is fixed for performing the work of this post. The post is part-time.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCU Part-time Programme Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The last date is 17 December 2026, and no application will be accepted after that date.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the JNCU Part-time Programme Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Only qualified teachers of colleges affiliated to Jananayak Chandrashekhar University, Ballia may apply.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the JNCU NSS Programme Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The applicant should be working as Reader / Lecturer (Selection Grade) or Lecturer (Senior Grade), should have served as NSS Programme Officer for at least 03 years, and should have done the NSS orientation course at a TOC / TORC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the JNCU Programme Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The applicant should be not more than 50 years of age at the time of selection of the Programme Coordinator.

faq.question: Q5. What is the honorarium for the JNCU Part-time Programme Coordinator?
faq.answer: An honorarium (Pocket Allowance) of Rs. 500/- per month is fixed for the post.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the JNCU Part-time Programme Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Send the attached application form, forwarded by your Principal / Head of Department, with a brief bio-data and relevant certificates, by registered or speed post to the Registrar, Jananayak Chandrashekhar University, Ballia, Shaheed Smarak, Near Surha Taal, District Ballia, U.P., PIN Code 277001.

faq.question: Q7. Can a college Principal apply for the NSS Programme Coordinator post at JNCU?
faq.answer: Principals of affiliated colleges who have an NSS background and the status of Reader may also be considered for appointment as Coordinator.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NSS orientation course compulsory for the JNCU Programme Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says the applicant should have completed the NSS orientation course at a Training Oriented Center (TOC) or Training Oriented and Research Center (TORC).
